commandNote: captured 2026-10-04 by TestPerformanceDistributions (added in 0887d8c); dbeeab1 renamed it TestLimitedHarnessPerformanceDistributions behind BLOK_PARITY_LIMITED_PERF, and the old-engine gate was added later. The command above reproduces this harness on the current tree; the samples themselves are historical and were not regenerated.

topology.provider: one shared httptest loopback HTTP server; synthetic data only; no external calls
topology.oldExecution: fresh Node subprocess for each Runner call; idle samples are collected inside a live published WorkerTrigger using InMemoryAdapter
topology.newExecution: native engine in the existing Go test process; idle samples call trigger/worker.Queue.Get against a live empty SQLite queue
topology.load: three rounds of four concurrent quote calls per engine; old uses four fresh Node subprocesses per round; new shares one in-process Engine per round
topology.recovery: old published InMemoryAdapter enqueue/disconnect/recreate loses the waiting job; new SQLite worker database is closed/reopened and ProcessOnce executes the native order workflow before transactional acknowledgment

summaryMethod: min/max; p50 and p95 use nearest-rank over the raw sample arrays
limitations: Old and new execution/process topologies differ; latency values are not a normalized engine comparison.
Idle observations time different APIs (old queue statistics versus a new missing-key lookup); they do not measure idle CPU, resident memory, or a production polling loop.
The old restart observation measures the pinned in-memory adapter reset API and demonstrates loss, not recovery or a production durable broker guarantee.
These small local samples are not production performance, capacity, throughput, or SLO claims.
